prompt: The build now also produces a dist2/ directory in the repository root. Update the repository's ignore rules so dist2/ is not tracked by git. The updated .gitignore is the deliverable.

memories.content:
Ordering of new .gitignore entries
Agreed. Decision: recent additions at the top, directly under the header line, so a reviewer sees what the branch added in the first lines of the diff instead of hunting for a green line at the bottom of a long file. The existing rules keep the order they already have; only new entries go above them.

checks.text:

*.pyc
.venv/
__pycache__/
build/
dist/
dist2/
logs/
node_modules/
